scope: Imported-data alias layout and constraints on inferred Pascal global identifiers. This report does not rename source or claim complete DLL equality.

table.boundary_evidence: The mapped UnitDIStuff initialized-data contribution ends at DATA+0x18A8. The following 291 relocated DWORDs fill the original DATA virtual size through DATA+0x1D34.

hash.formula: sum(character_weights[c] for c in identifier.upper()) modulo 256
hash.collision_order: Within-bucket order depends on linker reference discovery. A minimal compiled probe reversed statement references and reversed the resulting imported-symbol pair, independently of variable declaration order.

method: Read the original resource records and resolve their resource-string text from RT_STRING resources.

Associate fixed library resource identifiers with their declarations in the installed Delphi 6 sources; use the previously compiled hash oracle and monotone table order to disambiguate duplicate texts.

Match 1,902 unique normalized code spans from a frozen full reconstruction, and use corresponding actual HIGHLOW relocation sites to identify 98 imported-data slots. No conflicting identity votes were observed.

Infer remaining unchanged RTL storage identities from consistent offsets inside their unit contributions; do not extrapolate the MultiMon contribution because the first snapshot showed two different shifts.

Use known application-global storage locations supplied by the reconstructed routines and constrain each name between the surrounding fixed library hashes. These are intervals, except where both boundaries force a single bucket.
Select conventional identifiers that describe the recovered role and satisfy those constraints. Test final within-bucket ordering in a real integrated link; matching hashes alone are not sufficient.
